BIDDER SHALL POSSESS VALID GST REGISTRATION AND OTHER STATUTORY REGISTRATIONS APPLICABL E TO THE SERVICE. 9. BIDDER SHALL ATTEND THE PRE-BID MEETING/ SITE VISIT TO ASSESS THE SCOPE OF WORK BEFORE SUB MISSION OF THE BID. 10. Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 4. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 6.
